visual.name: bfusionEfficientFrontier
visual.description: Interactive Efficient Frontier chart with Capital Allocation Line, scatter plot, and cross-filtering for portfolio optimization analysis.

dataRoles.name: projectName
dataRoles.description: Plans[Name] — one row per investable project. The visual enumerates subsets of these to build the possible-portfolios universe.

dataRoles.name: projectValue
dataRoles.description: Per-project value / benefit (Y-axis aggregation). Typically SUM(Plans[Benefits]).

dataRoles.name: membershipValue
dataRoles.description: 0/1 measure that returns 1 if the current project is part of the current scenario. Use the 'Modeler | Membership 1' DAX measure.

dataRoles.name: scenarioName
dataRoles.description: ModelerScenario[Name] — drag onto the Legend (group-by) well. Each value renders as a colored star at the sum of its included projects.

dataRoles.name: targetBudget
dataRoles.description: Optional vertical cut-line at the budget constraint. Typically MAX(ModelerScenario[TargetBudget]).

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

mcSampleSize.displayName: Monte-Carlo samples when N exceeds cap

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
